newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: OPINION - Ivan Wong's comments on Malaysian palm oil.
newsitem.headline: OPINION - Ivan Wong's comments on Malaysian palm oil.

text.p: KUALA LUMPUR, Oct 21 - Both production and offtake in October exceeded our previous estimate. Partial data available indicated crude palm oil production rose 1.8 percent or 15,000 tonnes to an estimated 880,000 tonnes. Production in Malaysia rose around one percent or 6,000 tonnes to an estimated 653,000 tonnes. The seasonal increase in East Malaysia also moderated to around five percent from 24.4 percent in September and 37.3 percent in August. The oil extraction rate remained good, aided in part by favourable weather conditions in most crop areas. On an annual basis, production in the country expanded strongly by 14.5 percent.
